reviewPolicy: Recheck through a ticket when support, entries, configuration, plugin API, ecosystem facts, or parser formats change; expired rules emit a warning and are never fetched at runtime.

diagnostics.summary: Node does not satisfy the supported runtime range.
diagnostics.correction: Run doctor and the application on a supported Node version.

diagnostics.summary: Declared npm version is outside the release-construction range.
diagnostics.correction: Use the documented npm version when constructing a jQStar release; application package-manager choice remains yours.

diagnostics.summary: A resolved package version is outside the supported range.
diagnostics.correction: Select a supported version for this consumer and verify its resolved installation with your package manager.

diagnostics.summary: Distinct package versions or installed copies were detected.
diagnostics.correction: Review which application resolves each copy before choosing whether to deduplicate.

diagnostics.summary: Declared peer compatibility excludes the detected package version.
diagnostics.correction: Choose mutually compatible peer versions and check the package placement used by this consumer.

diagnostics.summary: Declared package range does not intersect the supported range.
diagnostics.correction: Review the declared range and intended supported version before editing your dependency manifest.

diagnostics.summary: Requested entrypoint or format is unavailable in the detected artifact.
diagnostics.correction: Choose a documented entrypoint and format available in the installed package version.

diagnostics.summary: Requested entrypoint is deprecated.
diagnostics.correction: Follow the linked replacement guidance before the documented removal release.

diagnostics.summary: The requested entrypoint and format are recorded as explicit input.
diagnostics.correction: Confirm this explicit argument matches the import your application intends to use.

diagnostics.summary: Declared plugin API range excludes this registrar version.
diagnostics.correction: Install a plugin whose declared registrar range includes the supported plugin API version.

diagnostics.summary: A known configuration schema upgrade is available.
diagnostics.correction: Run doctor --upgrade-config to review a configuration plan before explicit apply.

diagnostics.summary: Configuration uses an unsupported schema version.
diagnostics.correction: Use a compatible doctor version or restore a known configuration schema; unknown migrations are not guessed.

diagnostics.summary: Installed package metadata or entrypoint files disagree with the expected identity.
diagnostics.correction: Review package provenance and installed metadata; restore the intended artifact using your normal package workflow.

diagnostics.summary: Supplied registry ownership destinations disagree with current configuration.
diagnostics.correction: Review the application-owned copy destinations and assertion without overwriting edited recipes.

diagnostics.summary: jQuery UI dependency metadata was detected; review the coexistence and migration guide.
diagnostics.correction: Follow the coexistence and component migration guide for the jQuery UI features your application uses.

diagnostics.summary: jQuery Mobile dependency metadata was detected; migrate without loading its archived runtime.
diagnostics.correction: Use the no-runtime migration guide and native or supported bridge replacements for archived Mobile behavior.

diagnostics.summary: jQuery Migrate dependency metadata was detected; use the opt-in staged workflow.
diagnostics.correction: Run the staged opt-in browser workflow, investigate warnings, then remove Migrate and retest.

diagnostics.summary: A user-supplied Migrate warning category needs application review.
diagnostics.correction: Review the original application warnings in this category; counts do not authorize automatic rewrites.

diagnostics.summary: Metadata cannot establish runtime CDN, import-map, bundle, or plugin behavior.
diagnostics.correction: Exercise representative application pages to verify imports, runtime globals, and dynamically installed plugins.

diagnostics.summary: Metadata format or resolution is unsupported or unavailable.
diagnostics.correction: Select the workspace root and inspect unsupported or missing metadata manually.

diagnostics.summary: Installed metadata differs from the selected lockfile resolution.
diagnostics.correction: Review whether installed packages or lockfile resolutions represent the intended application state.

diagnostics.summary: Compatibility rules have passed their review date.
diagnostics.correction: Review release notes and install a package with current compatibility rules; no rules are fetched by doctor.

diagnostics.summary: The scan stopped at a documented resource boundary; results are incomplete.
diagnostics.correction: Treat this report as incomplete; inspect omitted metadata or select an independently resolvable project root.

diagnostics.summary: Required input is malformed, unreadable, or outside the supported contract.
diagnostics.correction: Check the indicated input against its schema, encoding, permissions, and documented supported format.

diagnostics.summary: The selected path is outside the permitted filesystem boundary.
diagnostics.correction: Select an existing project root and project-local regular files without traversal or escaping symlinks.

diagnostics.summary: Configuration or recovery metadata changed; no overwrite was authorized.
diagnostics.correction: Retain recovery files, inspect current and backup hashes, and prepare a fresh plan only after resolving the conflict.

diagnostics.summary: A configuration operation failed; inspect the reported recovery paths.
diagnostics.correction: Inspect current configuration and the reported backup/journal before retrying or rolling back.

diagnostics.summary: The command could not complete its local operation.
diagnostics.correction: Retain the report, inspect local file permissions, and report the failure with a minimal non-sensitive reproduction.
